Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Executive Office fixed-base desk game sprite
Subject: One compact corporate office desk: restrained walnut desktop, charcoal-green solid modesty/front panel, simple straight legs with brushed-metal feet. Two slim black monitors sit on the north/back edge, one left and one right, leaving a clear central gap. Monitor screen faces point NORTH toward the executive; we see their plain backs. Small plain keyboard lies on the north operator side. No papers or extra objects.
Composition: Camera is south, executive will sit NORTH facing south, visitor will sit SOUTH facing north. Show the SOUTH VISITOR-SIDE FACE, never operator drawers or operator knee-hole. Bilaterally centred straight-on frontal view with a shallow visible desktop, complete feet. Body width-to-height roughly 1.45:1.25 including low monitors. Keep both monitor tops low and the central gap broad so a real composited seated adult face and hands can remain visible.
Style and constraints: Elevated-front ORTHOGRAPHIC game-room camera, straight horizontal front edges, no isometric diagonal rotation, no perspective convergence. Match the established cosy hospital-management game room sprites: detailed hand-painted PIXEL ART, crisp stepped pixel edges, dark charcoal outlines of consistent medium weight, no blurry edges or gradients, restrained small colour clusters, upper-left lighting and faint contact shadow only. Muted sage green, blue-grey/navy, neutral charcoal, warm walnut and cream palette. One complete isolated empty object centred with generous clear padding on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. No people, labels, logos, readable text, letters, numbers, watermarks, room background, floor backdrop, blood or body detail. Polished contemporary corporate office, no gold, ornate carving, throne styling or personal trophies. Use the already-seen approved GamifySurgery room art in this conversation as the style guide.
One fixed appearance for upgrade Levels 1–5; keep the professional understated corporate finish.
